content:
marin: Morning microshift — quick synopsis and Qs. What I did: pushed a small KV-eviction tweak (rev d3f2) to canary, ran a micro-batcher smoke. Blocker: seeing a small p95 regression for short requests (~+8ms). Today: dig into profiler traces and get a reviewer for PR #842.

aj: Nice. I can review after standup. I repro'd locally with seq=8; ran `./tools/bench --seq 8` — quick numbers below. Attached flamegraph link will follow.

```text
p50: 15ms
p95: 62ms
p99: 120ms
notes: allocs up ~4% when slot reuse hits boundary
```

kai: Deployed a kernel change that reduces memcpy on KV fetches. On the canary cluster p95 for seq=8 dropped ~70 -> 58ms on two shards. I've only rolled to 2/3 shards so far. Watch /var/log/infra/oom.log for spikes.

lina: PR #842 — left a comment about slot-boundary off-by-one. Small fix. I can +1 and merge if tests are green. ETA review by 11:30 PT. Please post the profiler trace (flamegraph) here.

marin: @lina yep that's my PR. profiler: https://internal/graphs/fg/1769854320
Also @aj can you try with the cache disabled? `REDWOOD_CACHE=0 ./tools/bench --seq 8` — that'll rule cache in/out.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: canary-id=2026-03-17-11:02, image=infra/kernel:v2.9.7-d3f2

aj: ran with cache OFF -> p95 65ms (worse). So cache seems to help, regression not caused by cache. I added extra tracing to the PR branch (logs under `kernel/trace/*.log`).

kai: I'll re-run with quantized kernels disabled: `KERNEL_Q=0` and report back. Might be kernel selection for short sequences.

slo-bot: slo-alert: latency_p95_ingress > 60ms in us-west-2 for 2m, triggered at 11:08 — alert acknowledged, investigating.

marin: :thumbsup: action items — kai: re-run with KERNEL_Q=0 and post numbers; aj: review PR + attach flamegraphs; lina: merge after +1 and green tests; I'll monitor canary and post any regressions here. Will circle back by 12:00 PT.

aj: on it.
kai: starting now.
lina: will merge if tests pass.
marin: closing loop by 12:00 PT, will post final canary summary then.
